# BrioHR | Product Overview

BrioHR is a modular HRMS for South-East Asia covering core administration, remuneration, recruitment, performance and attendance. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
